steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each record is placed by its punch, its approval and its overtime against the limit.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 overtime figure is above the limit

findings.title: Overtime above the stated limit
findings.fix: Stop the overtime or get the approval

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] timesheets.csv:12  Overtime above the stated limit.
       Fix: Stop the overtime or get the approval.
[medium] att-line-b.csv:19  Missing punch.
       Fix: Ask for the correction.
[low] punches.csv:26  Timesheet not approved.
       Fix: Chase the approver.
Not checked: Work done outside the clock.
pros: Checks a missing punch, an unapproved timesheet, and overtime above the stated limit.
cons: Not checked: Work done outside the clock.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hr-daily-attendance skill on the records for this review.
